name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Soweto, where he spent countless hours watching touring car races on TV with his father. He initially pursued a degree in logistics management, but the roar of engines always beckoned him back. After graduating, he took a leap of faith and volunteered at local racing events, quickly proving his organizational skills and dedication. He's now eager to apply his academic knowledge and growing practical experience to a professional motorsport team.

Thabo approaches his role with meticulous precision and an unwavering commitment to efficiency. He believes that seamless logistics are the unsung heroes of any successful racing endeavor, ensuring that everything from spare parts to personnel arrive at the right place and time. While still developing his technical expertise, his dedication to meticulous planning and his proactive problem-solving skills make him a valuable asset. Thabo is known for his relentless work ethic and his determination to overcome any obstacle.

physical.description: Thabo is a powerfully built man with a warm smile and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down logistical details
Insists on double-checking every shipment manifest
Has a lucky charm: a miniature racing helmet keychain
